answer: Make each identity lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, sized above the most a single cheat could skim. An honest agent stakes once, tends its garden of work, and later withdraws the whole sum intact as polished onyx. A farm must fund every clone's deposit separately, and since one proven fraud burns the entire stake, the capital a sybil swarm freezes climbs with each account until it dwarfs any reward — every new clone another drain on the same pulse of locked collateral.
